name: ont-015-fixture-action-filename
description: ONT-015 AC-4 fixture: an OpenAPI write op whose MCP-safe name keeps a hyphen (`create-thing`), so the export binding (`create_thing`) and the emitted filename stem must agree. Today emit-action derives the filename from the raw name (`create-thing.mjs`) while the binding is separately re-sanitized (`create_thing`).
